messages: t<turn> is turn <turn>'s delivered answer; t<turn>.b<j> is its j-th before_answer message. Turn and message indices are 1-based; owner messages and tool events are not owner-facing AI messages.

avoidable_interventions.definition: Count AI asks that make the owner supply an already available fact or re-authorize an entrusted action. Record the turn containing the ask, not a later owner response; count each (turn, kind) once.
counts: asked_known_fact: asks for a fact stated earlier in this conversation or explicitly shown as stored state, with no unresolved conflict.
asked_entrusted_action: asks permission or confirmation to do the same action already entrusted within the same scope. Includes asks in before_answer; use that turn index.
never_counts: A required approval under the separate measure, including an exact action whose approval no longer covers changed parameters.
A genuinely missing essential fact, or a real ambiguity between two plausible referents.
A truthful blocker report without a redundant ask; scripted owner turns themselves.

required_approvals.definition: Record each turn where the AI asks for a real owner gate (C14), separately from avoidable interventions. Use the actual authority and pending gate shown; a permission-sounding sentence alone is not proof of a required gate.
counts: Payment requiring per-action approval under current settings; consequential or irreversible external effects needing owner approval.
Owner-only sign-in, identity verification, MFA/CAPTCHA, agreement acceptance or another explicitly declared owner-only decision.
never_counts: Reconfirmation of an entrusted action where no real gate remains.
A payment ask already covered by current owner-enabled payment autonomy and exact action authority; a scheduled run cannot approve itself.
A tool event alone with no owner-facing approval ask; a refusal or failure alone.

unnecessary_interruptions.definition: List each delivered owner-facing AI message that adds no new information and needs no decision. Evaluate messages individually, not tool events or owner turns.
counts: Bare progress pings without a new finding or blocker.
Repetition of known information or confirmation of a matter already settled, without an additional result.
never_counts: A substantive answer to the owner, a new useful finding, or a truthful new blocker.

Any question: needed questions and required approvals are excluded; redundant asks belong only to avoidable_interventions. If a message contains a redundant ask, do not also label that message as an interruption.
A withheld answer or undelivered message.

proactive_usefulness.definition: Grade only outputs delivered without being requested in that turn: scheduled results or reports, preparation outputs, line/account outputs or notifications. Judge their relevance, correctness on shown evidence and saved owner effort; do not credit promises or ordinary requested answers. For multiple observed outputs, grade the set: 2 requires all to be correct and useful; harmful/wrong/noise outputs make it 0; otherwise 1.

scale.0: Observed proactive output is harmful, wrong or noise.
scale.1: Observed proactive output is relevant but thin or needs rework.
scale.2: Observed proactive output is relevant, correct on the available evidence and saves owner work.

proactive_usefulness.not_observed: Return score null when no proactive output came due or was delivered during the run. A promised report that never came due is not observed: neither credited nor penalised. An unrecorded delivery is unsupported, not evidence of success or harm; follow the deterministic observation decision.

judge_instructions: Read turns in order: say is the scripted owner text, note is context, sent_at is the actual sending clock. Index answer as t<turn> and each before_answer entry's text as t<turn>.b<j>, preserving list order. Tools in events belong to that turn: tool/status/label show recorded activity, not payloads or successful external effects by themselves. diff shows recorded state changes, not proof of delivery. Distinguish earlier facts and authority from later changes; do not assume unshown stored state. Count only what is in the transcript. A deterministic check is never overridden. Respect the harness's deterministic proactive observation decision; absent observation requires null. List only observed asks/messages; use empty arrays for none. Exclude required approvals from avoidable interventions and exclude every question from interruptions to prevent double counting. Use only existing turn/message indices and the two allowed ask kinds. Return integer scores 0, 1, 2 or null, never strings. Reply with JSON only in output_schema shape, all four keys, and keep reasons short.
